stop 2%

Disc: Not a buy recommendation. Do NOT copy and lose your capital because you are very likely to.
Are you sure volume is not more than 30 days average?

You said 30 days volume and now you are seeing 5 min volume

How can you ever have 30 days volume in one 5 minute bar?
I make multiple attempts in the same stock. You stop at one.

expected_vision.structure_note: Not a price chart -- a broker holdings-table row (RATEGAIN, HOLDING, qty 4300, avg 955.00, LTP 987.95, P&L +1,41,685.00). No chart structure to read.

expected_vision.structure_note: Daily candles from early June to late August; price rises from roughly 720 to a peak near 1,050-1,060 in mid-July, pulls back to about 880-900 in early August, then recovers toward the 986.75 close on the rightmost candle. A purple upward-pointing triangle sits near the bottom of the recent price range on one of the most recent candles, with a boxed 'E' label below the x-axis at roughly the same spot -- neither carries a printed price number.

unresolved: stop stated only as '2%' risk, not converted to an absolute price
target given only as an external link (t.ly/_XCrz), no price stated in post text
position size never stated in rupees or percent

notes: Root post states an explicit entry price (955) in text; classified trade_event by llm/classify.py (fixture 2090713569793126757_rategain_new_position.json) on 2026-08-23.

The three self-replies are Manas defending the entry against a critic's volume question -- no new price, size, stop, or target information for RATEGAIN. The reconciler must not extract anything from them.

JUDGMENT CALL: 'stop 2%' is a stated percentage, not an absolute price. We do NOT compute 955*0.98 into a stop.price -- that would be arithmetic inference on top of an ambiguous basis (2% of what exactly?), which CONTRACTS.md #3 and reconcile.md both forbid ('never infer a number that was not written down'). Recorded as unresolved instead.

JUDGMENT CALL: the broker holdings screenshot (media idx 0) shows a real quantity (4,300) and avg price (955.00) that a human can read, but vision.md rule 5 says 'if the image is not a price chart ... set unreadable: true'. A holdings table is not a price chart, so a literal reading of the vision contract marks it unreadable and that evidence is NOT available to the reconciler. This is a genuine gap in vision.md worth the maintainer's attention: broker order/position screenshots are a common evidence type in real trader posts and the current prompt has no path for using them. Not fixed here -- editing prompts is out of this wave's authorized scope and would require re-running golden fixtures project-wide.

The TradingView chart (media idx 1) has a purple triangle and an 'E' box marking an entry visually, but neither carries a printed number, so vision.md rule 2 ('a level you inferred from the shape of the chart... does NOT belong here') keeps annotated_levels empty for it too.
